The pit FBX on disk (AmpulometPit/Exports/SM_AmpulometPit.fbx, 30,080 tris, the full mesh, no _Opt cut) is the one in Unreal: x/y bounds and tri count match; the reported Unreal z range (-8.3..75.0) is wider than in the FBX (-3.7..71.5), which no frame or scale error explains (x/y are exact) and which does not touch a z 0 socket or the neck; worth a look in the editor. Socket on the X axis just past the berm tips (x -329.3), so Unreal = Blender here. Neck: Soviet kit log revetment + six bag rows each side, each row started where it meets the pit (cheek stack, outer ring or berm toe) by rays against the pit FBX, plus 8 cm into it; mud + corduroy poles from the socket through the entrance to pit x -178 (clear of the ampoule crate). The cheek stacks already funnel the lane from ~+-80 to ~+-55, so the revetment stays straight at +-82.5 and only the floor narrows. Materials SovTrench_Wood, RL_Sandbag (as the kit). Rows are fitted to the pit FBX's jittered bags: re-run this script if the pit is regenerated.
